items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: And we still had Billy Franklin on trombone until he got hurt. That was in 1936 when he got hurt.

ctx.x: Yeah, Mitch-Bishop sprained his ankle. I think it was either sprained, or broke it. Anyway, he had trouble with it a long time. And a few minor injuries. The biggest one was when Franklin got his arm almost tore off and Cecil got killed.
That's still happening on the road, you know, the guys --
